productionStatus: Acceptance pending; this plan is not an installed model manifest

skinType.meaning: four source-label class probabilities, never severity

acne.method: YOLOX-S native384 tiled BGR plus separate shared-U-Net support
acne.countPolicy: active Pimple/individually reviewed active lesion only; scars, moles, freckles, whiteheads and blackheads retain their own semantics; source-coordinate NMS IoU0.3; no diffuse acne-area to count conversion

oil.method: local mask support plus real specular area/intensity
oil.meaning: visible shine area/intensity, not biological sebum

dry.method: native multiscale flake evidence; hair/dark-ringing/JPEG controls; no box-to-mask

redness.method: preserved global ridge head plus independent local natural LAB/chroma support
redness.meaning: global appearance grade and separate pixel color signal

tone.method: within-image illumination-controlled natural LAB variation, localized appearance support
tone.meaning: color variation, not a merged pigment disease class

lines.method: shared sigmoid U-Net and Gabor support restricted to outer canthi
lines.meaning: visible outer-eye lines, not brow/lash/forehead lines

dark.method: independent sigmoid mask and same-image adjacent-skin LAB/contrast

bags.method: independent shared-U-Net channel plus actual contour/fold support, whole lower-lid engineering ROI review
bags.meaning: visible bag contour appearance distinct from pigment or dark pixels

sag.method: pose/scale normalized MediaPipe 2D geometry plus real contour/fold image evidence and neutral-expression gates
sag.meaning: instant contour appearance proxy, no age/elasticity/mm or personal-reference ground truth

scorePolicy: Keep existing versioned fixed appearance scales until matched-grade or disclosed engineering appearance calibration passes. Never turn probability, attention, or presence boxes into pixel severity. Unavailable stays null.
rightsPolicy: Publisher README attribution retained; undocumented stock imagery excluded; other individual image rights unresolved until review. No automatic license grant from archive name.
trainingPolicy: Real required feature gradients/weight changes, finite epochs/time and plateau, safe transactional optimizer/scheduler/RNG/cursor state; validation selects and protected test stays closed until model/threshold frozen.
